title: .NET plugins
summary: Five .NET plugins: dotnet, ASP.NET Core, data, test and MSBuild. They pair with the C# and .NET rules.
details: Installs five .NET plugins (dotnet, ASP.NET Core, data, test and MSBuild) whose skills help Claude with .NET work. They are for C# and .NET developers and pair with the C# and .NET rules. They come from the dotnet/skills marketplace as skills that load only when used; nothing is shipped with the pack and no code runs unless a skill is used.
risk: Installed from the dotnet/skills marketplace; adds skills that load when used. Nothing is shipped here.
